Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1201
Claimant:
Brian Walsh
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
4-16-24
Claim received for a low-speed head-on collision. The insured's policy is active and the driver is named on it.
Claimant is represented by counsel, so all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
5-7-24
Reviewed the police report and statements from two witnesses. Both confirm the vehicle was involved in the collision
and that the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the time.
5-30-24
Photos from the scene and the other driver's account match the described impact. Vehicle damage is mostly
consistent with the reported force of the crash, though a few older scratches may predate this loss and will be noted
separately.
8-4-24
Nothing in the file suggests the damage occurred before the coverage start date. Prior policy records were checked
and show no earlier loss on this vehicle.
9-3-24
Claimant reported a shoulder injury following the collision. The injury is plausible for an impact of this type and
direction.
9-19-24
Medical records show the claimant had a minor strain in the same area several years ago, which healed fully. This
history has been noted and does not appear to be related to the current complaint.
11-12-24
Counsel forwarded the initial treatment records. Care followed a typical course, with physical therapy and follow-up
visits tapering as the claimant's range of motion improved.
11-19-24
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who confirmed the client's account. In each conversation to date, the claimant has
described the collision the same way.
11-21-24
Reviewed the latest treatment notes. The provider reports steady improvement and fewer visits scheduled going
forward, which is consistent with the expected recovery timeline.
12-1-24
File is current. Remaining items are the final medical bill and the vehicle repair invoice. Reserve will be reviewed once
both are received.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
